intro.title: Build secure cookie session strategy
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a secure cookie-based session strategy for a Node.js application. You will learn how to store user session data in encrypted cookies to maintain state across HTTP requests. The core programming concept involves using the `cookie-session` middleware to handle session creation, encryption, and validation. You will work with technologies like Express.js, HTTP cookies, and cryptographic signing to ensure session security. By the end, you'll have a functional session system that protects user data from tampering and unauthorized access.
intro.usecase: Secure cookie sessions are fundamental to user authentication in virtually every modern web application. When you log into platforms like banking dashboards, e-commerce sites, or social media feeds, your session is maintained through secure cookies that remember your identity across page refreshes. This pattern prevents unauthorized access to sensitive user data while providing seamless navigation through protected areas like account settings, payment forms, and personalized content panels. As a developer, implementing this strategy correctly ensures your users' data remains protected against common attacks like session hijacking or cross-site request forgery.
